english_title: Recognising and Responding to Getting Someone's Attention Politely
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: greetings & basic social contact — getting someone's attention politely
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to getting someone's attention politely; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Sophie politely gets Ms Lan's attention.
context_note_vi: Chị Sophie lịch sự thu hút sự chú ý của chị Lan.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Yes, Sophie? What can I do for you?
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, Sophie? Tôi giúp gì được cho chị?

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.english: Sorry to interrupt. Is now a good time?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi làm phiền. Bây giờ có tiện không?
